ammonia.reason: Low deamination of amino acids during 4-9 mo cloth-bound ripening; no surface flora.

animal_barnyard.reason: Cow milk only; very low p-cresol/indole from tryptophan catabolism.

bitter.reason: Moderate hydrophobic peptides from chymosin/plasmin proteolysis, mostly degraded by starter peptidases.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti; no 2-heptanone/2-nonanone blue-mold ketone pathway.

browning.reason: Maillard between residual galactose/lactose and lysine plus lipid browning when grilled.

buttery.reason: Diacetyl/acetoin from Lactococcus lactis citrate metabolism plus C10-C12 delta-lactones from milk fat.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Moderate lipolysis releasing butanoic/hexanoic/octanoic free fatty acids by starter esterases.

creaminess.reason: 33.5% fat, >48% FDM with cheddared protein matrix coating mouthfeel.

crumbliness.reason: Cheddared, milled and pressed curd with 34-39% moisture giving firm slightly open fracture.

firmness.reason: Low-moisture pressed cheddar-make with acid-driven calcium loss and cloth-bound aging.

floral_honey.reason: Low phenylacetaldehyde/2-phenylethanol from phenylalanine Strecker catabolism.

fruity.reason: Ethyl butanoate/hexanoate from esterification of fatty acids with ethanol by lactococci.

goaty.reason: No goat milk; no 4-methyloctanoic/4-ethyloctanoic branched-chain acids.

malty_nutty.reason: Strecker 2-methylbutanal/3-methylbutanal from leucine/isoleucine plus aged pyrazines, classic nutty Leicester note.

melt.reason: pH 5.2 rennet gel with demineralized casein flows on heating, cheddar-type melt.

mushroom_earthy.reason: Trace 1-octen-3-ol from linoleic acid oxidation; no bloomy rind metabolism.

oil_off.reason: Free oil release from coalesced milk-fat globules on heating at ~35% fat.

smoky.reason: No smoke application; no guaiacol/syringol phenols in typical make.

sour_vinegar.reason: Lactic acid from Lactococcus starter plus trace acetic acid, pH 5.2.

stretch.reason: Milled cheddared curd with no hot-water stretching; no aligned paracasein fibers.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Low methionine catabolism to methanethiol/dimethyl sulfide; mild cooked note from pasteurization.

sweet.reason: Residual lactose fermentation balanced by sweet amino acids proline/glycine and diacetyl caramel.

umami.reason: Glutamate accumulation from starter proteolysis during 6-month maturation.
